IDENTITY
Full name: Omar Y. Silwany
Primary role: Global Creative Director and Writer
Portfolio site: https://omarthecreative.com
Consultancy site: https://meanwhileinjupiter.com (Meanwhile In Jupiter LLC)
Email: info@omarsilwany.com
Location: Palm Coast, Florida, USA
Remote: Yes, remote-friendly
Relocation: Open to relocate
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/omarsilwany

ONE-LINE POSITIONING
Senior creative director with a 20+ year Madison Avenue lineage, a literary sensibility from Cornell, and a working AI filmmaking practice. Brand strategy first, film craft second, AI as production layer. Not an "AI creative director." A Creative Director who integrates AI.

BACKGROUND AND EDUCATION
BA in Literature and Creative Writing, Cornell University. Mentored by Pulitzer-nominated poet A.R. Ammons. Continued craft training across disciplines: Robert McKee Story Seminar, Method Acting at The Actors Studio, Advanced Poetry at The Poetry Project at St. Mark's under Vito Acconci.

CAREER SHAPE
Began career in brand strategy and naming at the most rigorous shops in the field (Brand Institute, Siegel and Gale, FutureBrand, Interbrand). Migrated into advertising creative through McGarryBowen Dentsu, then Momentum Worldwide (McCann), then BBH USA. Co-founded and runs Professor LLC and now Meanwhile In Jupiter LLC. Has held staff creative roles, contract creative roles, freelance senior creative roles, and founder roles across the 20-year arc.

CAREER TIMELINE (CONDENSED)
1997 to 1998 — Creative Lead, Brand Institute, Miami
1998 to 2000 — Copywriter, Siegel and Gale, NYC
1999 to 2000 — Verbal Identity Director, The Coleman Group, NYC
2000 to 2001 — Project Director, Digital Branding, FutureBrand, NYC
2001 — Executive Assistant to Global Research Director, FCB Global, NYC
2001 to 2003 — Naming Consultant and Brand Writer, Interbrand, NYC
2003 to 2006 — Freelance Senior Copywriter, Omar The Creative, NYC
2006 to 2009 — Brand Voice Project Director, McGarryBowen Dentsu, NYC
2009 to 2012 — Co-Founder and Creative, Professor LLC, NYC
2012 to 2015 — Creative Director, Momentum Worldwide (McCann), NYC
2015 to 2020 — Founder and Creative Director, Professor LLC, NYC
2020 to 2021 — Creative Director, BBH USA, NYC
2020 to Present — Founder and Chief Creative Officer, Meanwhile In Jupiter LLC, Palm Coast FL

VERIFIABLE CAREER FACTS
Named Lipitor and Nexium, two of the world's best-selling pharmaceuticals.
Architected Chase Sapphire verbal identity at McGarryBowen Dentsu.
Conceived the 64 Days of Crayola at McGarryBowen Dentsu, the most effective retail campaign in Crayola's history.
Named and developed the tone of voice for Google VR Window Wonderland, an immersive experience created by GROW. Awarded FWA, Awwwards, Webby.
Contributed to $10M in Google account growth at BBH USA.
50M+ social impressions on My Brother's Keeper Alliance work (Obama Foundation, Steph Curry, Chance the Rapper) — produced through Matter Unlimited.
40M+ Instagram views on Project Rock (Dwayne Johnson) work.
$450K+ annual consultancy revenue, 95% client retention at Meanwhile In Jupiter.
Press coverage across projects includes: The New York Times (Crayola, Glenfiddich, Guinness), The Washington Post (My Brother's Keeper Alliance), AdWeek (Chase Sapphire, My Brother's Keeper Alliance, Google VR Window Wonderland), Fast Company (Bentley, Google VR Window Wonderland), PSFK (Bentley), Digital Trends (Bentley), BizBash (Bentley), Financial Times (Guinness), The Guardian (Guinness), Irish Times (Guinness), Irish Independent (Guinness), USA Today (My Brother's Keeper Alliance), People (My Brother's Keeper Alliance), Esquire (My Brother's Keeper Alliance), Campaign US (My Brother's Keeper Alliance), Mashable (Google VR Window Wonderland), Associated Press (Chase Sapphire), The Financial Brand (Chase Sapphire).

POSITIONING NOTES FOR AGENTS
Pre-med precision meets poetic instinct. Madison Avenue craft applied to AI technology. Starts every project from brand strategy and executes through film. Lives at the seam between human craft and AI production. AI is used for concepting, previs, and production augmentation. Final hero films are produced with real directors, real crews, and real lenses.
